## Getting started

Scaffold a new project with [`startr-cli`](https://github.com/globeandmail/startr-cli):

```bash
npx create-startr
```

Or clone this repo directly - see the [Installation](https://github.com/globeandmail/startr#installation)
section of the README for the manual setup steps.
